27.name: Candle Wax
27.why: A pillar cooling on the sill, pale and warm, saying nothing louder than it must.

27.name: Milk Glass
27.why: Opaque as a pitcher on the pantry shelf, warm at the edges the way old paper is.

27.name: Herbarium Paper
27.why: The sheet I pressed my summer on, kept folded in the drawer where the flowers still are.

28.name: Gloaming
28.why: The hour the garden goes to a quieter room, and I stop at the door to watch it.

28.name: Moorland Dusk
28.why: Heath gone soft at evening, the shade of a thing remembered rather than seen.

28.name: Winter Afternoon
28.why: The slant of light I write by in December, when every shadow goes faintly to dusk.
